m: विड m. n. a kind of salt (either factitious salt, procured by boiling earth impregnated with saline particles, or a partic. kind of fetid salt used medicinally as a tonic aperient, commonly called Vit-lavan or Bit-noben, cf. विड्-लवण; it is black in colour and is prepared by fusing fossil silt with a small portion of Emblic Myrobalan, the product being muriate of soda with small quantities of muriate of lime, sulphur, and oxide of iron), Suśr.

विडंब् — {c10c} U. 1 To imitate, copy, resemble; (तं) ऋतुर्विडंबयामास न पुनः प्राप तच्छ्रियं R. 4. 17; वपुःप्रकर्षेण विडंबितेश्वरः 3. 52; 13. 29; 16. 11; Ki. 5. 46; 12. 38; Śi. 1. 6; 12. 5; 16. 58. --2 To ridicule, deride, mock; संमोहयंति मदयंति विडंबयंति निभर्त्सयंति रमयंति विषादयंति Bh. 1. 22; यथा न विडंब्यसे जनैः K. 109. --3 To cheat, deceive; एवमात्माभिप्रायसंभावितेष्टजनचित्तवृत्तिः प्रार्थयिता विडंब्य. ते Ś. 2. --4 To afflict, pain, molest. --5 To transform, distort.

विडंबनं --ना — 1 Imitation. --2 Disguise, imposture. --3 Deception, fraud. --4 Vexation, mortification. --5 Paining, distressing. --6 Disappointing. --7 Ridiculousness, mockery, a matter for laughter; इयं च तेऽन्या पुरतो विडंबना Ku. 5. 70; असति त्वयि वारुणीमदः प्रमदानामधुना विडंबना 4. 12.
विडंबित — p. p. 1 Imitated, copied. --2 Mocked, ridiculed. --3 Deceived. --4 Vexed, mortified. --5 Frustrated. --6 Low, abject, poor. --तं An object of ridicule.
विडंग — a. Clever, skilful. --गः, --गं N. of a vegetable and medicinal substance (largely used as a vermifuge).
